behavior_contract.authority: Operator correction 2026-09-30: SHORE LINE FUCKING BREAKS IS FUCKING DIRECTIONAL COPY NON FF BEHAVIOR
behavior_contract.decision_scope: Preserve directional behavior and its existing temporal law; do not copy non-FF glyph tables, atlas masks, cell allocation or presentation selectors.
behavior_contract.direction: Travel is toward the solid. The projected toward-solid vector determines the apparent direction (N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW); the crest tangent is a separate perpendicular shape/phase fact. A crest moving screen-right must bow toward the right-hand shore. Camera turns change projection, never source phase.
behavior_contract.front_law: In d255=distance/6*255: smoothstep forward from 176 to 0 for phase<0.72, then smoothstep rebound from 0 to 52.8. No linear sweep past the solid.
behavior_contract.admission_law: Half-width 26 in d255, valid direction, distance<=6, and wrap envelope smoothstep(0,0.05,phase)*(1-smoothstep(0.93,1,phase))>0.15. Direct contact clamps effective distance to at most 0.18. Preserve source-relative broken runs rather than an enclosing ribbon.
behavior_contract.family_rule: One behavior law for terrain, retained static and moving solid contacts; geometry supplies the contact direction/segment, not a separate oscillator.
behavior_contract.representation_boundary: Use FF-owned authored directed combinations and real native spacing. The behavior envelope may govern whole-part admission and flat per-glyph paint; it must not blend masks, rotate glyphs, import the extended atlas or make one glyph per non-FF cell.
behavior_contract.current_implementation_gap: After FL-4907 cutover, TrueFFFrameRenderer invokes the feature renderer. Its class-to-role selector maps SHORELINE to the static shoreline role and TERRAIN_RELIEF to ridge; other classes use generic roles. It does not select CREST or SHORE_BREAK. Moving front publication and the complete required shoreward/contact/rebound behavior therefore remain unwired in this route. The old midpoint/linear-law diagnosis below is historical, not the current call path.

implementation_mismatch.status: OPEN: the current feature route does not select the directional moving break role
implementation_mismatch.summary: P5 calls tff_feature_role_word and tff_feature_select per site. tff_feature_class_role returns SHORELINE, RIDGE or GENERIC only. The retained old tff_water_role helper is not included by the feature shaders. Its linear midpoint law is not evidence of live W07 behavior after the cutover.
implementation_mismatch.historical_mismatch: At 5354a757f, the old source review found ffw_break_stage linear travel from 1.5 to -0.3 without a rebound split and tff_water_role sampling the stationary shore midpoint at distance zero. That review cited true_ff_water_surface.glslinc:143-148,322-330 and true_ff_role_water.glslinc:37-53. Preserve the failed attempt; do not restore the deleted water-surface path.

manual_audit.reason: Snapshot disappearance triggers a short last-position shard burst; disappearance is not certified collision.
manual_audit.preserve: One expiry event per projectile identity, last observed position and finite burst lifetime.
manual_audit.structure: Sparse outward whole shards around the source endpoint; no generic smoke blob or guaranteed-hit icon.
manual_audit.falsifier: Expiry is reported as confirmed hit, burst moves with camera or repeats after lifecycle release.
manual_audit.unverified: Shared impact carrier contains FF routing metadata; the pure birth/expiry path is the non-FF meaning evidence.

true_ff.meaning: When a projectile disappears from the server snapshot, the current client emits a short outward shard burst at its last observed world position; that trigger does not itself distinguish a confirmed hit from expiry.
true_ff.depiction: Short outward contour shards open around the source burst position, leaving a blank center and air rather than a filled explosion disk; do not mislabel an inferred disappearance point as confirmed contact.

manual_audit.reason: Safe-region boundary, target disc and round state are essential navigation and hazard information, not optional storm decoration.
manual_audit.preserve: Preserve server live/target centres and radii, stage/tick deadlines, outcome and run identity; absent envelope stays unpublished and the renderer never advances the round.
manual_audit.structure: Clear native boundary/contact and concise actual stage/time text; distinguish current legal region from target without a fabricated volumetric wall or damage calculation.
manual_audit.falsifier: A target disc shown as current safety, zero-default absent ring drawn as real, or countdown tied to render time fails.
manual_audit.unverified: Final native boundary/HUD coverage, queued actor/ring coherence and gameplay readability remain unexecuted.

true_ff.meaning: Server ring publication supplies the safe-region geometry, shrink target, stage and round timing. The client decodes it into the same queued authority tick as actor poses; an absent envelope remains explicitly unpublished.
true_ff.depiction: A connected world storm boundary and native round/countdown text communicate safe space and remaining time.

candidates.directed_mirrors: D5/D8: source orientation projects continuously into the authored angle/turn rows. Reverse a directed row and swap ／↔＼, /↔ヽ, ノ↔ヽ and (↔) only for a source-facing change, then rederive real spaces from native advances. No software-flipped glyph mask or frozen camera.
candidates.negative_space_occlusion: D6: nearer source parts keep their complete foreground contour. Terminate the farther support at current whole-feature visibility and spell the remaining gap with U+3000/U+0020. Empty interior, structural gap and depth transparency are distinct; never share a glyph across unrelated objects.
candidates.anchored_animation_part_timing: server round/stage/time publication and queued authority tick, never a client wall-clock resimulation; no renderer holds. Each part retains its source identity and authored spelling between representation changes. The comparison A/B/C is not a sequence of frames, a repeated-frame hold or a second simulation clock.
candidates.near_far_behavior: The owned feature hierarchy selects complete near/far representations before arc admission. A closed node contributes its single extent/dot representative without a late cap; visible open boundaries, thin features and material seams remain obligations. Camera motion changes projection, not source feature identity. Paint remains flat per glyph.

true_ff.rationale: The ring schema and tick-associated client decode establish a source meaning, not a completed FF boundary. Adapt the authoritative geometry and countdown; never resimulate legality, substitute wall-clock time or interpret unpublished sentinel fields as a live zero-radius storm.
authoring_refs: ascii-art-authoring §2 whole candidates; §3 foreground/overlap; §15 native text
FL-4359 D7: UI text is distinct from scenery glyphs
open_work: Consume the tick-associated ring geometry and deadlines for a sparse world boundary and native countdown. Preserve unpublished state and server legality; do not add a full-screen storm texture or a second local round clock.
true_ff.integration_gap: Ring publication and client decode establish the meaning. True FF boundary/countdown depiction and visual acceptance remain open; an unpublished envelope must not be displayed as a zero-radius live round.

required.aa: D6: Connect the actual storm/safe-region boundary with empty interiors and separate countdown fields; do not interpret unpublished sentinel radius/time as a live storm or erase player/thin structures.

tempo.behavior: server round/stage/time publication and queued authority tick, never a client wall-clock resimulation; no renderer holds.

required.paint: Flat per-glyph FG/BG; no shading, gradient, blended mask or per-pixel tint.
required.cost: Count-sized safe-region boundary and round/countdown text in the shared admitted feature/text stream; no screen-sized pass.
